core_competencies.description: Ability to attentively process oral presentations, video overviews, historical narratives, and environmental maps while identifying key geographic and civic features.

evaluation_levels.descriptor: Actively listens and observes; extracts subtle nuances, historical causes, map coordinates, and civic processes; synthesizes observations independently.
Listens attentively; identifies main geographical features, historical facts, and civic roles accurately with minimal guidance.
Understands primary facts when stated clearly; requires assistance to connect observed geographic features or historical timelines.
Struggles to maintain focus during presentations; misses major concepts or instructions.

core_competencies.description: Capability to articulate social science concepts, present map analyses, explain historical cause-and-effect, and engage in democratic classroom discussions.

evaluation_levels.descriptor: Articulates complex historical, geographical, and civic ideas fluently using precise NCERT terminology; leads group discussions with empathy and confidence.
Presents ideas clearly with appropriate vocabulary; explains core concepts like time calculations or Panchayati Raj effectively.
Communicates basic facts but struggles with structured presentation or technical terminology; hesitant during class discussions.
Displays difficulty expressing thoughts orally; relies heavily on prompting.

core_competencies.description: Skill in analyzing textbook source passages, deciphering historical inscriptions, interpreting map legends, and evaluating case-study scenarios.

evaluation_levels.descriptor: Comprehends complex primary and secondary sources; identifies underlying themes, cross-references evidence across chapters, and critically evaluates sources.
Reads textbook passages independently; extracts definitions, key terms, and main points accurately.
Understands straightforward narrative text; struggles with complex case studies, mathematical map scales, or ancient terminology.
Requires significant reading support to comprehend basic textbook content.

core_competencies.description: Ability to construct point-wise answers, solve mathematical time/scale calculations, complete case-study HOTS tasks, and write reflective social science essays.

evaluation_levels.descriptor: Writes logical, highly structured 3-mark and 5-mark responses with precise marking-scheme points; solves mathematical time/scale problems flawlessly.
Writes clear, point-wise answers with correct facts; solves standard mathematical geographic calculations accurately.
Answers cover partial information; minor calculation or logical errors in multi-step questions.
Incomplete answers; significant difficulty with structured writing or mathematical problem-solving.

portfolio_logs.project_title: Interactive Globe & Map Scale Model Project
portfolio_logs.summary_writeup: Constructed a 3D spherical globe model and a flat thematic map of India. Calculated local solar times for Greenwich, Mirzapur (IST), and Tokyo using the 1° = 4 minutes rotation formula. Applied a scale of 1 cm = 200 km to plot major cities.
portfolio_logs.peer_feedback: Excellent accuracy in calculating IST (+5:30) offset and drawing intermediate compass points.
portfolio_logs.teacher_feedback: Demonstrates outstanding mathematical precision in longitudinal solar time conversion.
portfolio_logs.reflective_takeaway: Realized how Earth's rotation creates distinct solar times and why a single standard meridian (82.5° E) is essential for India.

portfolio_logs.summary_writeup: Designed an educational infographic illustrating the 5 oceans and 7 continents. Included a scientific diagram showing phytoplankton oxygen production and an NDMA safety protocol flowchart for tsunami warnings.
portfolio_logs.peer_feedback: The diagram showing how marine algae produce over 50% of atmospheric oxygen was very clear.
portfolio_logs.teacher_feedback: Strong environmental awareness and excellent visual presentation of marine ecosystem protection.
portfolio_logs.reflective_takeaway: Understood that protecting oceans from plastic waste is vital for our own survival since oceans produce more than half our oxygen.

portfolio_logs.summary_writeup: Created a comparative chart mapping the ancient Tamil Sangam 5 Tiṇais (Kuriñci, Mullai, Marutam, Neytal, Pālai) to modern landforms, highlighting how geography shapes occupations, housing, and cultural life.
evidence_artifacts: Alluvial Soil vs Black Soil Chart
portfolio_logs.peer_feedback: Great comparison between mountain life and river plain farming.
portfolio_logs.teacher_feedback: Insightful integration of ancient Indian eco-literary wisdom with modern geomorphology.
portfolio_logs.reflective_takeaway: Learned how human communities adapt their lifestyle, housing, and clothing to local mountain, plateau, or plain environments.

portfolio_logs.project_title: BCE/CE Historical Timeline & Archaeology Lab Log
portfolio_logs.summary_writeup: Constructed a master chronological timeline illustrating events across the BCE/CE divide without a Year 0. Documented how archaeologists use stratigraphy and Carbon-14 dating to determine artifact ages.
portfolio_logs.peer_feedback: Clear explanation of why there is no Year 0 when calculating time spans across BCE and CE.
portfolio_logs.teacher_feedback: Flawless mathematical timeline construction and thorough understanding of historical evidence.
portfolio_logs.reflective_takeaway: Discovered that history is an evidence-based science where archaeologists cross-verify physical ruins with written records.

portfolio_logs.project_title: Etymological Journey & Constitutional Map of India
portfolio_logs.summary_writeup: Researched the historical names of the Indian subcontinent (Sapta Sindhava, Jambudvīpa, Bhāratavarṣha, Indoi, India) and prepared a presentation on Article 1 of the Constitution.
portfolio_logs.peer_feedback: Fascinating trace of how 'Sindhu' became 'Hidu', 'Indoi', and finally 'India'.
portfolio_logs.teacher_feedback: Exceptional historical research bridging ancient literature with modern constitutional principles.
portfolio_logs.reflective_takeaway: Appreciated how Article 1 harmoniously connects our ancient civilisational roots ('Bharat') with our global identity ('India').

portfolio_logs.summary_writeup: Drafted a scale floor plan of a Harappan city featuring Citadel, Lower Town, covered drainage lines, and Lothal dockyard. Analyzed binary-decimal weights and Meluhha trade records.
portfolio_logs.peer_feedback: The street drainage and watertight Great Bath model were highly detailed.
portfolio_logs.teacher_feedback: Outstanding architectural analysis of India's earliest urban revolution.
portfolio_logs.reflective_takeaway: Impressed by the extraordinary civic sense, sanitation, and peaceful trade of Harappan society 4,500 years ago.

portfolio_logs.summary_writeup: Compiled an analytical portfolio covering UNESCO Vedic oral chanting, Upaniṣhadic dialogues (Satyakāma Jābāla, Gārgī), Buddha's Eightfold Path, Mahāvīra's Ahiṃsā, and sacred groves (Kavu).
evidence_artifacts: Four Noble Truths & Eightfold Path Mind Map
portfolio_logs.peer_feedback: Deeply moving writeup on universal non-violence (Ahiṃsā) and ecological reverence.
portfolio_logs.teacher_feedback: Thoughtful, empathetic analysis of India's foundational spiritual and philosophical heritage.
portfolio_logs.reflective_takeaway: Understood that Ahiṃsā and moral cause-and-effect (Karma) provide timeless guidance for ethical living today.

portfolio_logs.chapter_title: Unity in Diversity, or 'Many in the One'
portfolio_logs.summary_writeup: Created a multi-cultural tapestry project mapping simultaneous harvest celebrations (Makara Sankranti, Pongal, Magh Bihu, Lohri) and traditional handloom weaves across Indian states.
portfolio_logs.peer_feedback: Showed beautifully how different states celebrate the exact same solar movement under distinct names.
portfolio_logs.teacher_feedback: Excellent celebration of cultural pluralism and national integration.
portfolio_logs.reflective_takeaway: Realized that Indian unity is an internal synthesis where diversity enriches our collective national identity.

portfolio_logs.project_title: Bhil 'Halma' Mutual Aid Case Study & Kinship Log
portfolio_logs.summary_writeup: Logged family kinship terms across Indian languages, advocated for egalitarian sharing of domestic work, and documented the Bhil tribe's 'Halma' voluntary community service tradition.
evidence_artifacts: Bhil Halma Voluntary Service Case Report
portfolio_logs.peer_feedback: The 'Halma' example of villagers coming together to build water contours without money was inspiring.
portfolio_logs.teacher_feedback: Heartwarming reflection on family equity, elder care, and indigenous community solidarity.
portfolio_logs.reflective_takeaway: Learned that community support and unpaid care work create the essential trust that holds society together.

portfolio_logs.project_title: Three Organs of Government & Rule of Law Blueprint
portfolio_logs.summary_writeup: Constructed an organizational chart illustrating the Legislature, Executive, and Judiciary. Simulated a parliamentary debate on Universal Adult Suffrage and constitutional checks and balances.
evidence_artifacts: Rule of Law vs Arbitrary Power Analysis
portfolio_logs.peer_feedback: Clear explanation of how checks and balances prevent any single organ from abusing power.
portfolio_logs.teacher_feedback: Mastery of foundational democratic concepts and civic responsibility.
portfolio_logs.reflective_takeaway: Understood that rules and democratic institutions exist to protect individual rights and maintain public harmony.

portfolio_logs.chapter_title: Grassroots Democracy – Part 2 (Local Government in Rural Areas)
portfolio_logs.project_title: Gram Sabha Direct Democracy & GPDP Mock Assembly
portfolio_logs.summary_writeup: Organized a mock Gram Sabha assembly where students acted as village voters, Ward Panchs, and Sarpanch to democratically debate groundwater conservation and pass a GPDP village plan.
portfolio_logs.peer_feedback: Direct participation in the mock Gram Sabha showed how direct democracy works in practice.
portfolio_logs.teacher_feedback: Inspirational demonstration of grassroots democracy and youth civic leadership.
portfolio_logs.reflective_takeaway: Experienced how direct democracy enables every citizen to participate in decision-making and hold leaders accountable.

portfolio_logs.chapter_title: Grassroots Democracy – Part 3 (Local Government in Urban Areas)
portfolio_logs.project_title: Municipal Ward Audit & Source Waste Segregation Campaign
portfolio_logs.summary_writeup: Conducted a local ward civic audit evaluating street lighting, water supply, and garbage collection. Launched a school-wide door-to-door wet (green bin) and dry (blue bin) waste segregation campaign.
portfolio_logs.peer_feedback: The waste segregation campaign made an immediate practical difference in school waste handling.
portfolio_logs.teacher_feedback: Exemplary active citizenship combining civic theory with practical urban environmental action.
portfolio_logs.reflective_takeaway: Realized that clean, efficient cities depend as much on responsible citizen habits as on municipal administration.

portfolio_logs.project_title: Economic Value Addition & Sevā Experience Log
portfolio_logs.summary_writeup: Calculated value addition in manufacturing (raw timber to finished chair), categorized economic compensation modes (salaries, wages, fees, payment in kind), and logged volunteer Sevā hours in a community kitchen.
portfolio_logs.peer_feedback: The mathematical formula for value addition was clearly demonstrated with real-world examples.
portfolio_logs.teacher_feedback: Deep economic understanding paired with genuine respect for the dignity of all human labor.
portfolio_logs.reflective_takeaway: Learned that all honest work—whether earning income or providing unpaid domestic care—has equal moral dignity.

portfolio_logs.project_title: Tri-Sectoral Value Chain & Paper Recycling Impact Report
portfolio_logs.summary_writeup: Traced the complete supply chain of a textbook from forest logging (Primary) to paper milling (Secondary) to logistics/retail (Tertiary). Calculated environmental savings for paper recycling (1 Tonne = 17 Trees).
evidence_artifacts: Paper Recycling Environmental Impact Metrics Sheet
portfolio_logs.peer_feedback: The AMUL cooperative story showed how small milk farmers eliminated middleman exploitation through teamwork.
portfolio_logs.teacher_feedback: Outstanding synthesis of economic sectors, cooperative movement history, and conservation metrics.
portfolio_logs.reflective_takeaway: Understood how the primary, secondary, and tertiary sectors depend on each other, and why cooperatives empower small producers.
